name: Frequency Annealing
aliases: Coarse-to-Fine Optimization via Positional Encoding Windowing
definition: A regularization technique that implements coarse-to-fine optimization by windowing the frequency bands of the positional encoding. It eases in the influence of each frequency band through a parameter α, shrinking the bandwidth of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) as α increases to allow higher frequency deformations.
